output.post: Your diffs, side by side, in 38 milliseconds. termdiff renders a 10,000-line diff in 38ms — an order of magnitude faster than existing pagers. Zero config. Static binary. Drops into your git setup. {APP_URL}
thread_extension: Most fancy diff pagers fail on monorepo-scale changes. They’re slow, misalign lines, or can’t highlight word-level changes in side-by-side view.
termdiff uses Rust + tree-sitter to parse and render diffs with surgical precision. It’s built for engineers who review diffs all day.
4,200 GitHub stars in the first year. Now in Homebrew core. Used daily in large-scale OSS and monorepos. Try it: {APP_URL}
alt_variants: Tired of waiting for your diff pager to render? termdiff shows side-by-side, word-level changes in 38ms — even on 10k-line diffs. {APP_URL}
If you live in the terminal and review diffs daily, you need termdiff. Side-by-side. Word-level. Zero config. 38ms latency on a 10k-line diff. {APP_URL}
